column1: # Label cleaning, layer 2: same-sound choice sets (cleaning plan "Layer 2"; training/cleaning.py).
# One set per line, "member<TAB>member[<TAB>...]": spellings of the same spoken word or words, offered to the model
# in this order (then "can't tell"). Spans are every whole-token, case-insensitive occurrence of a member, longest
# first, without overlaps. A member ending in "*" is option-only: offered, but it does not start a span (the
# standard spelling in a dialect set).
# Disabled by the net-harm check (cleaning plan Check 3, on the human-reference labels; the model's choices matched
# the reference less often than the label as written): maybe/may be, anyway/any way, everyday/every day, gap/GAAP,
# --- dialect spellings (the standard spelling is option-only)
# --- contextual spelling-variant groups of the term lists
# --- moved out of layer 1 (forms whose written form is also an ordinary word, a name or a typed token)
# --- left as written in the synthetic forms; real labels contain them
